title: Paranormal investigators bring ghost stories, gear to T.B. Scott library

content:
Just in time for Halloween, Merrill residents can get a firsthand look at how ghost hunters work when Paranormal of Wisconsin visits the T.B. Scott Free Library.
Jason and Michelle Bertram, founding members of the group, will present “Paranormal of Wisconsin: Exploring the World of Ghost Hunting” from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 17, 2026, at the library, 106 W. First St.
The Bertrams founded Paranormal of Wisconsin in 2009. Since then, they have investigated reports of paranormal activity in businesses, private homes, and other sites around the Midwest.
At the program, they will share stories from those investigations, show evidence they have collected, and walk attendees through the equipment and techniques investigators use. Time will be set aside for audience questions.
The library said the program is meant for longtime believers, skeptics, and anyone who is simply curious about the unexplained.
For more information, call the library at 715.536.7191 or visit its website or social media pages.
